summary: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
whenToUse: Use when an idea is too big for one agent session and the way forward should be planned as decision tickets on the issue tracker before building.
whenNotToUse: Doing the work itself: it produces decisions, not deliverables, unless the effort's notes say otherwise
